description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:754: ValidatedPath.depth doc says 'Number of certificates in the validated chain minus one' and then adds a note that it may include self-issued intermediates that RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 excludes from pathLenConstraint. This creates confusion: a caller checking 'did the path meet the max_path_len constraint?' cannot use depth directly — they'd need to recount non-self-issued intermediates. The field should either be named chain_len_minus_one to make its raw nature clear, or the doc should include an explicit warning: 'This is NOT the RFC 5280 path length; do not compare to max_path_len.'
notes: ValidatedPath.depth doc at lib.rs:755 already explains the semantics clearly: 'This equals chain.len().saturating_sub(1)' and notes it may differ from RFC 5280 path length. No change needed.
title: ValidatedPath.depth doc misleads: counts all certs minus 1, not RFC 5280 path length
